title: Marketing reports
subtitle: Funnel, revenue and geo by department for Ads and growth. The Leaflet map has its own page.

mapa.title: Clinics map
mapa.subtitle: Two maps: real GPS (consent) and approximate department location. A tenant with GPS never appears on the approximate map.
mapa.legend: Priority: saved tenant GPS (if they consented). Otherwise the department centroid from the main site is used.
mapa.gps_hint: Clinics that consented and saved coordinates. Exact position.
mapa.approx_hint: No GPS yet: department centroid from the site. Ads orientation only.
mapa.empty_gps: No GPS clinics match these filters.
mapa.empty_approx: No approximate clinics match these filters.

kpis.gps_hint: They accepted location and we already have XY.
kpis.departamento_hint: No GPS: approximate point from site (Ads).
kpis.paid_hint: Live subscription on a non-Free plan.
kpis.free_hint: Free plan or no paid subscription.

filters.label: Show segments
filters.hint: Paid is on by default. Check Free if you also want that segment.
filters.empty: Check Paid and/or Free to show report sections.

sections.paid_hint: Subscription on a non-Free plan (trial, active, grace or suspended).
sections.free_hint: Free plan or no live subscription. Strong conversion targets for Ads.
sections.churn_hint: Paid at least once and are no longer in good standing (expired, suspended, free or cancelled).
sections.comparativo_hint: Paid vs free in departments with the most clinics.
sections.heatmap_hint: Relative intensity by department (darker = more clinics).
sections.flujo_hint: Ops funnel: trial → active → grace → suspended.
sections.crecimiento_hint: New clinics created per month (paid vs free).
sections.ingresos_hint: Payments in processed status (paid plans), last 12 months.
